_doc: Aspen Motorsports Park through the Lake Murray chain (tools/ship_track.sh; ONE-CHAIN §4 row 10, Kevin 2026-11-01: 'get a complete track list and installed by morning'). The draft is the engine's own on the OSM raceway way 192313782 (source.type from_track over source/osm_fixes.json, smooth_window 0: gps -> elev -> project -> mesh), then the underlay drops data/track.obj into loop.blend as GEN_* collections (scripts/blender/underlay.py). Authoring happens in that blend (AUTH_*), the prep / exporter run from airoso's scripts/ac, the gates run on the BUILT kn5. The workshop lives OUTSIDE airoso. Rehearsed offline 2026-11-01 up to elev (3DEP is unreachable from the cloud box): gps -> 1,676 m, 561 points from 64 OSM nodes, close_gap 10 m; with a zero-elevation stand-in the projection rotates the ring 382 points and vertex 0 lands 9.4 m from route.start_at on the N-S chute, heading S, clockwise. source/aspen.kml is the pre-re-source trace (near Denver, 39.76 N) and is not read: source.type is from_track.
_owed: First pass = the draft through the chain, no authoring yet: no pit lane (east of the S/F chute, _orientation_doc), no kerbs where the real ones are, no buildings. The engine-era T1 (ledger 0025, v0.66.3) is withdrawn; the track enters at T0 through the chain. Read first on the Windows run: the gps print (1.68 km, 561 points) and 'ring rotated by 382 points'; the mesh step's bridge-span line (a mountain site with real relief: a span on this course is the detector reading the wrong ground until shown otherwise); then drive_test's slope kinks: 0025 carried a 13 cm/m kink in finished_centerline y at V1 stations 1517-1519 inside the passing budget, elevation-side (the stations moved with the 1,600 -> 1,676 m lap), the first place to look if the profile reads rough.
